limitations: Image comparisons against reference cover one synchronized frame per camera per task (16 pairs), not every frame. PLUS intentionally changes viewpoints, illumination and backgrounds.

10 Hz reference vs 20 Hz PLUS metadata differ. Exact full-length action sequences and near-exact same-index state traces support preserving native frame indices without resampling; metadata alone does not prove physical recording rate.

3013/3071 episodes exactly match a reference action trajectory; remaining 58 share the same verified schema and preserve raw PLUS values, but are not claimed to be exact original-reference trajectories.
The base model pretrained on original LIBERO trajectories. SFT grouping prevents duplicate SFT train/validation trajectories; validation is not pretraining-unseen.
Near duplicate screen compared aligned prefixes (MAE <0.005 or >50% identical action frames). It does not prove absence of every possible time-shifted or semantically similar trajectory.
Rollout checkpoint selection on the same 80 trials is selection, not an independent final test.
